hash_methods.canonical_packet: Remove only the top-level packet_sha256 field; serialize all remaining packet data with Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False); hash its UTF-8 encoding. The self-field is excluded.
hash_methods.definition_context: Hash the UTF-8 encoding of lean.approved_definition_context serialized with Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False); preserve array order.
hash_methods.raw_input: Hash the exact input.json bytes read from the pathname.
hash_methods.run_file: Serialized as sorted-key, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False JSON encoded as UTF-8 with one trailing newline. No run hash or output hashes occur inside this record.
hash_methods.statement: Hash the UTF-8 encoding of the decoded lean.statement string with no Unicode normalization or newline changes.

actual_input_read_actions: Read the designated input with cat through exec_command.
Read the same designated input as raw bytes with Python pathlib.Path.read_bytes for verification and reconstruction output.
isolation_and_exposure.compiled_status: The packet reports compiled=true; no compilation or independent source verification was performed.
isolation_and_exposure.restriction_enforcement: Agent-observed restriction to the designated input; no separate operating-system isolation attestation is claimed.
